==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Panhua:''' You're here for some grub? Finally found the time to drop by today, huh?
:{{DIcon}} Let me check the menu first
:{{DIcon}} Gourmet Rumors
::'''Panhua:''' Clear soup? Oh, you mean broth, right?
::'''Panhua:''' You've asked the right person. The secret is just one thing: [[salt]]!
::'''Panhua:''' Without salt, even the best ingredients won't make tasty broth.
::'''Panhua:''' If the salt is right, the soup is perfect!
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Panhua:''' Hmm, I've been trying out a new recipe lately. Well, somewhat new-ish.
::'''Panhua:''' Life used to be tough for us before coming to Jinzhou. We had to do whatever we could to feed ourselves.
::'''Panhua:''' Our Ma Xiaofang was just a child then, but she was always so kind and selfless. She gave as much of her food to the elderly as she could.
::'''Panhua:''' It broke my heart to see her go hungry at times. But one day, I managed to catch a wild rabbit and made a stew with some fresh greens for her. I still remember that smile on her face to this day.
::'''Panhua:''' And now, our Xiaofang... Should I call her [[Chixia]] now? She's all grown up and even works as a Patroller! She dropped by recently and told me how she missed that stew.
::'''Panhua:''' So I thought it would be nice to recreate it and relive those flavors together.
----
::'''Panhua:''' How to make food taste better? Well, buckle up, you're in for a treat. 
::'''Panhua:''' Heat control, choice of spices, when you should turn up the heat for stir-fry, when to slow cook your stew... Every detail matters.
::'''Panhua:''' Mahe would say it's important to get fresh ingredients, and he's right on that, but seasoning is even more important. 
::'''Panhua:''' At my restaurant, nothing less than perfection is acceptable. Seasoning is crucial for a good dish! Mahe... He just won't get it.
::'''Panhua:'''Well, he does make some good fish soup, though...
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave 
{{Dialogue End}}
